concern: EIA rows are generating units, not contracts or full projects.
implemented_response: Primary unit-level estimates are cluster weighted; uncertainty is bootstrapped by plant-development cluster; language is restricted to reported generating-unit delivery.

concern: Projects already in the September 2015 pipeline have unknown prior histories.
implemented_response: A 12-month burn-in is prespecified; archive-start projects are excluded from the primary cohort.

concern: Recent or long-duration projects may remain planned at May 2026.
implemented_response: Horizon outcomes require sufficient observable follow-up; unresolved observations are censored.

concern: Cancellation prevents later operation on the observed identity.
implemented_response: Operation and cancellation are modeled separately and as terminal multistate transitions.

concern: Future schedule revisions or stages could inflate performance.
implemented_response: Features are cumulative only through each origin month; temporal entry cohorts are project-disjoint.
Average precision, Brier score, calibration, per-class metrics, and decision curves supplement ROC-AUC and accuracy.

concern: Plant/generator identifiers or reporting organizations can change.
implemented_response: Identity-change counts are audited; unreconciled units are retained only as censored observations.

concern: Headers and available geography fields changed over 2015-2026.
implemented_response: Direct header-based parsing and stable primary predictors are used; missingness is explicitly audited.

concern: Flexible AI may fit administrative idiosyncrasies.
implemented_response: Simple Markov and logistic baselines, validation tuning, calibration, and subgroup checks are required. Prespecified benchmarks use temporal testing; post-inspection custom models are labeled exploratory and require new-cohort confirmation.

concern: Predictive associations do not identify causal delivery mechanisms.
implemented_response: All effect tables are labeled adjusted associations; causal verbs are prohibited.
